Hyderabad, Telangana
Available with 30 days notice.

Node.js Developer, Zoho — Apr 2025 - Present
Built and maintained customer-facing APIs and services using Node.js and GraphQL to support a multitenant SaaS product. Implemented GraphQL resolvers and schema stitching, optimized resolver performance to reduce average query latency by ~35% through batching and selective field resolution. Developed server-side modules in TS and Express.js, added Lambda-based background processors for asynchronous tasks and used SQS to coordinate job queues. Integrated with RDS for relational data storage and designed efficient query patterns to lower DB CPU usage. Collaborated with frontend engineers using React and maintained source control and CI workflow via Git; tracked work and bugs in Jira.

Skills: Node.js, TS, Express.js, RDS, Lambda, SQS, GraphQL, React, Git, Jira

Education
B.E., Information Technology, Pune University
